package postgres

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

func TestCourseCatalogFiltersRequireActiveHierarchyForPublicLists(t *testing.T) {
	groupID := "9cdd012b-44ce-4f26-872e-1a0c214e2316"
	levelID := "b0502515-792e-4dc0-99be-590e70fa4722"
	trackID := "f6cbf555-57e2-432a-a3f0-5cf58dc3139b"

	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		filter filters.CourseFilters
		want   []string
	}{
		{
			name:   "group",
			filter: filters.CourseFilters{CourseGroupID: &groupID, CatalogActiveOnly: true},
			want:   []string{"JOIN course_group cg", "cgc.status = 1", "cg.status = 1"},
		},
		{
			name:   "level",
			filter: filters.CourseFilters{LevelID: &levelID, CatalogActiveOnly: true},
			want:   []string{"JOIN course_group cg", "JOIN course_level cl", "cgc.status = 1", "lcg.status = 1", "cl.status = 1"},
		},
		{
			name:   "track",
			filter: filters.CourseFilters{TrackID: &trackID, CatalogActiveOnly: true},
			want:   []string{"JOIN course_group cg", "JOIN course_level cl", "JOIN track t", "cgc.status = 1", "lcg.status = 1", "tl.status = 1", "t.status = 1"},
		},
	}

	repo := CourseRepoPG{}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			query, _, _ := repo.buildListBaseQuery("ru", "c.id", tt.filter)
			for _, fragment := range tt.want {
				if !strings.Contains(query, fragment) {
					t.Errorf("query does not contain %q:\n%s", fragment, query)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCourseCatalogFiltersKeepAdminVisibility(t *testing.T) {
	trackID := "f6cbf555-57e2-432a-a3f0-5cf58dc3139b"
	query, _, _ := (CourseRepoPG{}).buildListBaseQuery("ru", "c.id", filters.CourseFilters{TrackID: &trackID})
	for _, fragment := range []string{"cgc.status = 1", "lcg.status = 1", "tl.status = 1", "JOIN track t"} {
		if strings.Contains(query, fragment) {
			t.Errorf("admin query unexpectedly contains %q:\n%s", fragment, query)
		}
	}
}

func TestCourseCatalogVisibilityFilterUsesDedicatedColumn(t *testing.T) {
	visible := false
	query, args, _ := (CourseRepoPG{}).buildListBaseQuery("ru", "c.id", filters.CourseFilters{CatalogVisible: &visible})
	if !strings.Contains(query, "c.catalog_visible = $") {
		t.Fatalf("query does not filter catalog_visible:\n%s", query)
	}
	if len(args) != 2 || args[1] != false {
		t.Fatalf("args = %#v, want language and false visibility", args)
	}
}

func TestCourseCatalogOrderUsesActiveCanonicalHierarchyPath(t *testing.T) {
	query, _ := (CourseRepoPG{}).buildListQuery(
		"ru",
		"c.id",
		filters.CourseFilters{CatalogOrdered: true},
		&filters.SortOptions{Field: filters.SortFieldTitle, Order: filters.SortOrderDESC},
	)

	for _, fragment := range []string{
		"JOIN LATERAL",
		"JOIN course_group cg ON cg.id = cgc.group_id AND cg.status = 1",
		"JOIN course_level cl ON cl.id = lcg.level_id AND cl.status = 1",
		"JOIN track t ON t.id = tl.track_id AND t.status = 1",
		"catalog_path.track_order ASC NULLS LAST",
		"catalog_path.level_order ASC",
		"catalog_path.group_order ASC",
		"catalog_path.course_order ASC",
		"c.id ASC",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(query, fragment) {
			t.Errorf("catalog query does not contain %q:\n%s", fragment, query)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(query, "COALESCE(ci.title, ci_fallback.title) DESC") {
		t.Fatalf("client sort unexpectedly replaced authored catalog order:\n%s", query)
	}
}

func TestCourseCatalogOrderUsesSelectedTrackLevelSlugPath(t *testing.T) {
	trackSlug := "foundation"
	levelSlug := "beginner"
	query, args := (CourseRepoPG{}).buildListQuery(
		"ru",
		"c.id",
		filters.CourseFilters{
			TrackSlug:      &trackSlug,
			LevelSlug:      &levelSlug,
			CatalogOrdered: true,
		},
		nil,
	)

	for _, fragment := range []string{"t.slug = $2", "cl.slug = $3", "catalog_path.track_order"} {
		if !strings.Contains(query, fragment) {
			t.Errorf("catalog query does not contain %q:\n%s", fragment, query)
		}
	}
	if len(args) < 3 || args[1] != trackSlug || args[2] != levelSlug {
		t.Fatalf("args = %#v, want language followed by selected slug path", args)
	}
}

func TestCourseSlugFiltersShareOneActiveHierarchyPath(t *testing.T) {
	trackSlug := "foundation"
	levelSlug := "beginner"
	query, args, _ := (CourseRepoPG{}).buildListBaseQuery(
		"ru",
		"c.id",
		filters.CourseFilters{TrackSlug: &trackSlug, LevelSlug: &levelSlug},
	)

	for _, fragment := range []string{
		"JOIN track_level tl ON tl.level_id = cl.id",
		"t.slug = $2",
		"cl.slug = $3",
		"cgc.status = 1",
		"t.status = 1",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(query, fragment) {
			t.Errorf("catalog query does not contain %q:\n%s", fragment, query)
		}
	}
	if len(args) != 3 || args[1] != trackSlug || args[2] != levelSlug {
		t.Fatalf("args = %#v, want language and selected slug path", args)
	}
}
